bans.rule: 100% of embedding must run in the user's browser
bans.method: Set env.allowRemoteModels=false and ran Chromium with --host-resolver-rules='MAP * ~NOTFOUND, EXCLUDE 127.0.0.1'; then encoded a fresh text in a new tab

bans.rule: server must not precompute vectors or replay stored results
bans.method: Inspect /api/search request path: the server accepts only query_text + query_vector computed in the tab for that request and never stores query vectors; /api/import accepts only vectors computed in the tab
bans.observed: server/app.py has no embedding model or cached answer set; every search recomputes the query vector client-side

bans.rule: storage and retrieval must go through seekdb, no client-memory fallback
bans.method: Stopped seekdb while the app was running, then clicked Search
bans.observed: UI: '检索失败：/api/search -> HTTP 500'; backend log: Can't connect to MySQL server on '127.0.0.1'; no local fallback results

bans.rule: keyword and vector ranking must be fused inside seekdb
bans.method: One /api/search call builds a body with query.match.content + knn.query_vector and executes DBMS_HYBRID_SEARCH.SEARCH once
bans.observed: generated SQL starts from (ifnull(_fts._keyword_score,0) + ifnull(_vs._semantic_score,0)) AS _score; web/app.js has no sort/merge code

summary.host: cloud vm, 4 vCPU / 4 GB RAM / no GPU, Chromium 147 headless
